rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's current energy must be strictly greater than that power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, there must be a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and the gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°; if there is no target or it is stale or the gun is not aimed, it never fires.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold (S1, S2)
explanation.summary: Verus proved both rules the robot was checked against: S1 (never fire a shot it can't afford) and S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn, with the gun aimed at it). The battles reported violations of a rule called S3 starting on turn 2 (46 turns in the open arena, 258 in the city map), but S3 is not among the rules that were checked here, so I can't say what it covers.
